learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparing numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Chose It stays the same from same/down/up before settlement.
observations.exploration: Premature G rejected: infinity bigger than S0. S set G10,A3,B8. A reducedB8→7. B reducedG10→9. G settled9; reverse toB11>7.
observations.reveal: G10 then9, three roads cheaper than direct; smallest label safe because alternate route passes at least as large label and costs only add. Run-specific reverse comparison11>7.
observations.visual: Screenshot dark1257x936: four labeled nodes, five edge costs, clear compact graph; explanatory label and single next-step instruction. Bottom continuation extends beyond viewport.
observations.chrome: No-history preview banner verified. Visible trust-count ignored; trust panel unopened.

prediction.reason: Prediction distinguishes tentative from final label.

interaction.reason: Settlement plus wrong-action feedback exposes update rule.

payoff.reason: Uses exact run to explain update and safety invariant.

clarity.reason: Arithmetic and current-best labels keep path understandable.

transfer.reason: Reusable algorithm condition is described but no new application.
transfer.evidence: Smallest-label safe when costs only add.

visualExplanation.reason: Graph and numeric label change central.
visualExplanation.evidence: Four-node weighted graph and route update.

playfulness.reason: Can choose wrong town with feedback; fixed graph constrains exploration.

depth.reason: Tentative labels, relaxation and settlement invariant.

complexity.reason: Supported multi-step arithmetic and tentative-versus-final invariant.
complexity.conceptualDemand: Track several best costs and safety condition.
complexity.interfaceBurden: low; town buttons with feedback and step text.

whyCool: Settling B replaces G10 with9, making a longer chain visibly cheaper than the straight road.
caveat: Only one fixed positive-cost graph; no altered-cost or second-case application.
missingEvidence: Accessibility modes: keyboard, focus, contrast, phone, zoom/reflow, motion untested
